semantic_fragments.content: Clause 212.10.1.1 Amendment: The tests of IEC 60601-1-12:2014 Clause 10 and IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012 15.3 shall be performed on the same sample of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER after the cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES of 201.11.6.6 of this document have been performed unless there are no cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES specified in the instructions for use. If more than one PROCEDURE is specified in the instructions for use, each PROCEDURE shall be so tested.

Laboratory accuracy test supplementary information for combination conditions: 1. Midpoint of humidity and ambient temperature (25℃, 55%RH); 2. Upper limit of humidity + upper limit of ambient temperature (39.5℃, 90%RH); 3. Upper limit of humidity + lower limit of ambient temperature (10.5℃, 90%RH); 4. Lower limit of humidity + upper limit of ambient temperature (39.5℃, 20%RH); 5. Lower limit of humidity + lower limit of ambient temperature (10.5℃, 20%RH). TRTS – Measured temperature of REFERENCE TEMPERATURE SOURCE; TTUT – Measured temperature of CLINICAL THERMOMETER under test; TRCT – Measured temperature of REFERENCE CLINICAL THERMOMETER. Note: reference temperature source and reference clinical thermometer are the same one thermometer.
